body:
Reframed the founder's own request: 'The Men should have their own channel' is about NPCs, not the still-missing player-team system that had been walkie-talkie's own standing blocker since the reverse-port. New BIGO_WALKIE_TEAM_THE_MEN gives every Man a real, shared channel; new server_walkie_transmit() wired into both real dispatch radio moments. New PARENA/stdlib/big_o/walkie_callsign.prn decides which canned callsign a dispatch event represents -- the real, buildable half of 'robot speak via tts in parena', investigated and correctly scoped down (VS0 can't do TTS, BIG_O has no audio subsystem, SHANKPIT's own audio.c named as the real future path). bigo_walkie_talkie_test.c extended to 10 assertions + real scratch integration harness (ASan/UBSan clean) both pass. bazel 33/33 green, clean builds. PARENA 2479e81, BIG_O 4ba8deb.

⚓ ☃
title: Walkie-talkie goes live -- The Men's own channel + robot-speak callsigns (NORTHSTAR §28)
